intent: Continue the depth-2 flattening: lift i3 config out of periodic_background, drop the redundant misc/testsAndMisc-bash nesting, and fix the path references the previous flattening commit missed.

misc/testsAndMisc-bash/ was a directory named after the repo it already lives in. Its contents moved up to misc/, and its stray .gitignore moved with them so the media-ignore rules keep applying.

Fixed conftest.py's tools path and the three i3 test/installer paths that the earlier bulk rewrite mangled into scripts/i3blocks/.
